title: C#: Intermittent Handle is not initialized when instantiating a PackedScene referencing a cached CompressedTexture2D
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in Godot v4.6.dev2.mono

### System information

Ubuntu 25.04 25.04 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (RPL-P) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900H (20 threads) - 30.51 GiB memory

### Issue description

When a scene that references a texture is instantiated in C#, the engine consistently throws an exception (under specific project layout) inside ScriptManagerBridge.SwapGCHandleForType, saying “Handle is not initialized.”

The error appears to happen when a cached native Resource is reused, and the engine tries to convert a released weak GCHandle into a strong one.
When attaching a debugger, the issue disappears.



### Steps to reproduce

approximate sequence:

// Step 1
var texture = ResourceLoader.Load<CompressedTexture2D>("res://t.png");
// ...
// Step 2
var scene = ResourceLoader.Load<PackedScene>("res://s.tscn"); // s.tscn has a Sprite2D using t.png

// Step 3
scene.Instantiate();

Error Output

ERROR: System.InvalidOperationException: Handle is not initialized.
   at System.Runtime.InteropServices.GCHandle.FromIntPtr(IntPtr value)
   at Godot.Bridge.ScriptManagerBridge.SwapGCHandleForType(IntPtr oldGCHandlePtr, IntPtr* outNewGCHandlePtr, godot_bool createWeak) in /root/godot/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotSharp/Core/Bridge/ScriptManagerBridge.cs:line 1280
   at: void Godot.NativeInterop.ExceptionUtils.LogException(System.Exception) (/root/godot/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotSharp/Core/NativeInterop/ExceptionUtils.cs:113)
   C# backtrace (most recent call first):
       [0] void Godot.GD.PushError(string) (/root/godot/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotSharp/Core/GD.cs:366)
       [1] void Godot.NativeInterop.ExceptionUtils.LogException(System.Exception) (/root/godot/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotSharp/Core/NativeInterop/ExceptionUtils.cs:113)
       [2] Godot.NativeInterop.godot_bool Godot.Bridge.ScriptManagerBridge.SwapGCHandleForType(nint, System.IntPtr*, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_bool) (/root/godot/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotSharp/Core/Bridge/ScriptManagerBridge.cs:1280)
       [3] void Godot.NativeInterop.NativeFuncs.godotsharp_method_bind_ptrcall(nint, nint, System.Void**, System.Void*) (/root/godot/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotSharp/Godot.SourceGenerators.Internal/Godot.SourceGenerators.Internal.UnmanagedCallbacksGenerator/Godot.NativeInterop.NativeFuncs.generated.cs:380)
       [4] Godot.GodotObject Godot.NativeCalls.godot_icall_1_79(nint, nint, int) (/root/godot/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotSharp/Generated/NativeCalls.cs:703)
       [5] Godot.Node Godot.PackedScene.Instantiate(Godot.PackedScene+GenEditState) (/root/godot/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotSharp/Generated/GodotObjects/PackedScene.cs:130)

At the point of failure (_instance_binding_reference_callback):

gchandle.get_intptr() = 0x0
gchandle.is_weak() = true
gchandle.is_released = true
script_binding.owner->get_class() = CompressedTexture2D
refcount = 2
Object::cast_to<Resource>(script_binding.owner)->get_path() = res://t.png

Hypothesis:

The texture (CompressedTexture2D) is loaded from C#, creating a managed wrapper whose weak handle is stored in the native resource cache.

Later, the managed wrapper is GC-collected, releasing its handle, while the native resource stays cached.

When the scene referencing the same texture is instantiated, the cache reuses that native resource and attempts to upgrade the old weak handle to a strong one.

Because the handle pointer is now invalid (0), GCHandle.FromIntPtr throws instead of creating a new managed wrapper.


When attempting to reproduce this behavior in other projects,

scene.Instantiate() never attempts to perform a GCHandle swap (_instance_binding_reference_callback is not called at all for the texture owned by the Sprite2D).
In the affected project, however, instantiating the same kind of scene does trigger a handle swap for the CompressedTexture2D (res://t.png),


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

The issue always occurs under the same build of the my project, but may disappear if the code layout changes slightly
Cannot reproduce in a minimal reproduction project, even with similar resource setup
Disappears when a managed debugger is attached
